name: component-decomposer
description: Decompose, design, and grade a zero-dependency web component (Custom Elements, signals, FACE, no native form elements) AND how components nest + wire (compose) up to the module, on two crossing axes — COMPOSE (layer → anatomy → API → composition → coherence, incl. the primitive → component → module tier ladder, seams / slots / overflow) and REALIZE (geometry → element → semantics → interaction → fidelity) — scored separately, backed by a gated rubric, a deterministic geometry engine (the (height-glyph)/2 padding law + the XS–2XL ramp), a contract-card linter, a composition-card linter (tier-consistency · seam · overflow · slot-presence grid), and family recipes for controls and overlays. Hands the app shell / page region grid UP to layout-decomposer. NOT for a function graded on spec & execution axes (code-decomposer), a proof graded on its logic (proof-decomposer), code generation (ui-build-components), the app shell / page layout (layout-decomposer), or token math (ui-build-tokens).
